_description: Images BUILT INTO the bg-zammad-mcp container. Every entry here force-dispatches a release when its digest moves (see check-base-images.yml), so only images whose contents actually ship inside our artifact belong in this file. redis:8-alpine used to be listed and is not: it is a docker-compose sidecar that appears nowhere in the Dockerfile, so its digest moving produced content-free version bumps — three of the releases up to 0.1.8. Compose images are already watched by Dependabot's docker-compose ecosystem, which opens a PR instead of cutting a release.
